content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Ropar Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-11-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) for research positions in the Department of Chemistry.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Postdoctoral Fellow under the supervision of Prof. C. M. Nagaraja.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Postdoctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Postdoctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. degree in Chemistry or Materials Science. Candidates with a thesis submission certificate are also eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for IIT Ropar Postdoctoral Fellow jobs?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month plus HRA as per the institute rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications via email is 07-11-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through email by sending their application, brief research proposal, and detailed CV to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this Postdoctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing of applications followed by an online interview of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of IIT Ropar for this notification?
faq.answer: You can visit the official project website at http://www.iitrpr.ac.in/CMNagaraja for further updates and details.
